content.what_it_is: MATLAB script (Mase-Kirby benchmark postprocessing) computing standard-deviation errors between FUNWAVE station output and measured gauge records. Loads model stations sta_0002..sta_0012 (L5-10), storing eta in cm into model(:,k-1) (L9) plus an unused stacked array z (L8); time base from last station (L11-12). Defines a filename table fnam mapping columns to measured files r2d470..r2d025 in depth order (L17-28: column 1=r2d470.dat deepest, column 12=r2d025.dat shallowest). Loads all 12 measured records into en (L30-34); builds data_time=[0:N-1]*0.05 (L36); copies measured columns 2..12 to data(:,1..11) (L37-39), i.e. drops the deepest gauge (r2d470) to match model stations 2..12. For each of 11 pairs computes std_data, std_model and echoes relative_error=abs(std_data-std_model)/std_data*100 (L41-47, unterminated so prints). Final aggregate error=rmse(std_model,std_data)/max(std_data)*100 (L49, echoed). No plots; no writes.
entities: script variables: fdir @L3, k @L5, num @L6, gage @L7, z @L8, model @L9, time @L11, model_time @L12, fnam @L17-28, gage_m @L32, en @L33, data_time @L36, data @L38, data_eta @L42, model_eta @L43, std_data @L44, std_model @L45, relative_error @L46, error @L49
calls: clear all @L1; sprintf @L6, @L31; load @L7, @L32; std @L44, @L45; abs @L46; rmse @L49; max @L49
unresolved: Measured records are raw gauge units while the model is converted to cm (L9); the comparison at L44-46 assumes r2d*.dat are already in cm -- units not verifiable from this file (the companion fft script applies scale_fac=0.01 to the same r2d470.dat).
z (L8), model_time (L12), num inside the second loop (L31), and data_time (L36) are computed but never used; the variable name error shadows MATLAB's built-in error function (L49).
rmse() (L49) is not defined here; requires external function.

No time-window alignment or truncation is applied before std comparison (unlike comp_mkskew.m's 400-sample cut) -- model and data records of different lengths/durations are compared whole; whether that is intended cannot be resolved here.
The fnam column order (L17-28) maps measured files by depth to gauge index; the deepest gauge column 1 (r2d470) is loaded but excluded by the shift at L37-39.
